newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 shares up on Q1 earnings optimism.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 shares up on Q1 earnings optimism.

text.p: Shares of retailer Pier 1 Imports Inc rose on Wednesday amid growing conviction the company's first quarter earnings would beat estimates.
The company was due to report earnings on Thursday and would hold an investor conference in New York, analysts said. The First Call consensus estimate was $0.24 per share.
"They will likely beat estimates," said Budd Bugatch, an analyst at Raymond James. "The earnings will be below $0.28 per share, but probably between $0.24 and $0.27 per share."
Loeb Associates analyst Walter Loeb said: "Their earnings will probably be above Street expectations. They did very well in the last quarter."

The company was well-positioned to take advantage of a growing trend towards spending money on the home and family rather than on clothes and the individual, said Otto Grote, an analyst at Derby Securities.
